02 / RESEARCH

Research & publications.

My research began with decentralised identity and secure communication. My current interests include inspectable AI systems, retrieval evaluation and generative vision. I bring that curiosity to both research and software engineering.

03 / ABOUT

A little about me.

I like learning by making something work.

My interests include language models, computer vision and 3D reconstruction. I enjoy building a working version of an idea, trying it out, and working through what needs to improve.

I’m interested in software engineering, AI/ML engineering and research opportunities. I’d like to contribute to useful projects, learn from the people around me, and keep developing as an engineer.
